αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl. (αἵ μοι ἕποντο ’which followed me’) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό: fem. nom. pl. demonstrative ’they’ (ἔνθ’ αἵ γ’ ’there they’)
αὐγῇ: αὐγή — light, radiance, sunlight; fem. dat. sg.
αὐλείῃσι: αὔλειος — of the courtyard, belonging to the αὐλή; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις), with θύρῃσι: ’courtyard doors’
αὐτός: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’he himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼ … αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’you yourself’ (ὄφρα καὶ αὐτός ’so that you too yourself’)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’) · also masc. nom. sg., of a thing: ’it itself’ (αὐτὸς … σίδηρος ’iron of itself’)
αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own works’): ’of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. governed by ἄγχι ’near, close to’: ’her’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτῆς ’close beside her’) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a ship, fem.), governed by a noun: χρεὼ ... αὐτῆς ’a need of it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a raft, fem.), governed by a preposition: ἐπ’ αὐτῆς ’upon it’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, possessive with a noun: νόος ... αὐτῆς ’her mind’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’her’, governed by a preposition, of a monster: ἀπ’ αὐτῆς ’away from her’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of the olive), governed by ἀγχόθι ’near’: ἀγχόθι δ’ αὐτῆς ’and near it’ · also intensive with a noun, fem. gen. sg.: αὐτῆς Ἰθάκης ’Ithaca itself’ · also ὁ αὐτός ’the same’, fem. gen. sg. with the article: τῆς αὐτῆς ἀγγελίης ’the same news’ · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun, of a woman speaking: ἐξ ἐμεῦ … αὐτῆς ’from me myself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a chair), after ἐκ: ἐξ αὐτῆς ’out of it’
αὐτῇ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’for herself’ · also plain anaphoric pronoun referring to a thing, dat. sg. with ἐν: ’in it’ (ἐν αὐτῇ, of the ship) · also reinforcing a 1st-person pronoun: ’myself’ (ἐμοί περ αὐτῇ, μοι αὐτῇ ’for me myself’) · also reinforcing a 2nd-person pronoun: ’you yourself’ (σοὶ ὧδ’ αὐτῇ ’for you yourself’) · also dat. sg. of a thing, no ἐν, ’against it’ or ’against her’, with ποτικέκλιται (referent uncertain: pillar or queen) · also plain pronoun, dat. sg. with μίσγεται: ’with her’ (οὐδέ τις αὐτῇ μίσγεται ’nor does anyone consort with her’) · also plain pronoun, dat. sg. after ἅμα: ’with her’ (ἅμα δ’ ἀμφίπολοι φέρον αὐτῇ, of Circe) · also intensive with a noun, fem. dat. sg. with ἐν: ’very, same’ (αὐτῇ ἐνὶ χώρῃ ’in that very place’)
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βίην: βίη — strength, might, force; fem. acc. sg.
βλέφαρ: βλέφαρον (pl. βλέφαρα) — eyelid; neut. acc. pl., elided (βλέφαρ’ = βλέφαρα): ’eyelids’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γούνατα: γόνυ — knee; neut. nom. pl., epic γούνατα (= Attic γόνατα)
γρηῒ: γρηῦς — old woman; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic γραΐ, from γραῦς)
γρηῢς: γρηῦς — old woman; fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic γραῦς)
γυναικῶν: γυνή — woman; fem. gen. pl., partitive with δῖα: ’heavenly-one of women’ · also partitive with ἀρίστη: ’best of women’ · also possessive gen. with a noun: ἔργα γυναικῶν ’the works of women’ · also gen. after a verb of surpassing, ’above, beyond women’ (περίεσσι γυναικῶν) · also gen. pl. dependent on a noun of speech, ’of … women’ (φάτιν ἀνδρῶν ἠδὲ γυναικῶν ’the talk of men and of women’) · also fem. gen. pl., partitive with indefinite τις: ’one of the women’ (τις … γυναικῶν) · also fem. gen. pl. in apposition with δμῳάων: ’women (servants)’ (γυναικῶν δμῳάων ’women servants’)
γῆρας: γῆρας — old age; neut. nom. sg.
δάκρυον: δάκρυον — tear; neut. acc. sg., by-form of δάκρυ
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δήνεα: δῆνος — plan, wile, counsel (used only in the plural, epic and poetic); neut. acc. pl.
δι: διά — through; prep. + acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through (the night)’ · also + gen.: ’through, through the midst of’ (δι’ αὐτῶν ’through the midst of them’) · also + acc., causal: ’through, by reason of’ (δι’ ἀφραδίας ’through folly’)
δύνανται: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 3 pl.
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δὴν: δήν — for a long time, long; adv.
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb: ’the house’
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο) · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’ (ὡς εἰ … ἱκοίατο ’as if they had come’) · also ὡς εἰ, ’as if’, before a noun with no verb of its own (ὡς εἰ κέρα … ἠὲ σίδηρος ’as if horn or iron’)
εἰπέμεν: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic εἰπεῖν)
εἰπέμεναι: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. inf., epic (= Attic εἰπεῖν)
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’ · also in the idiom εἰς ὅτε (κε) + subj., ’until the time when’ (εἰς ὅτε κέν … καθέλῃσι ’until … brings down’)
εἰσαφίκοιτο: εἰσαφικνέομαι — arrive at, come to; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., potential with κεν: ’would reach’
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’) · also with opt., of an aim in view: ’in case, to see if’ (εἴ τινά … λάβοι ’in case he might catch someone’) · also in ὡς εἴ τ’ + opt., ’as if’ · also in ὡς εἴ τε with no verb or optative expressed: ’as if’
εἴποι: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. opt. 3 sg.
εἴπω: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 1 sg.
εἴρυσθαι: εἴρυμαι (= ἐρύομαι) — guard, protect, watch over; pres. inf.
εἵματ: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. acc. pl., elided (εἵματ’ = εἵματα)
εὐρύκλεια: Εὐρύκλεια — Eurycleia, Odysseus’s old nurse; nom. sg.
εὗρον: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ηὗρον) · also aor. 1 sg.: ’I found’ (εὗρον ἔπειτ’ … ἑταίρους)
ζωὸς: ζωός — alive, living; masc. nom. sg.
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle · also with the relative ὅθι, no connective force: ὅθι θ’ ’where’ · also epic τε after a relative, no connective force (οὕς θ’ ’which’)
θέσαν: τίθημι — put, make; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔθεσαν): ’made’ (ἀνάπυστα θέσαν ’made known’)
θαλάμων: θάλαμος — chamber, room; masc. gen. pl.
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θυμαλγέα: θυμαλγής — heart-grieving, bitter; masc. acc. sg. (epic -έα = Attic -ῆ)
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (μελιηδέα θυμὸν ἀπηύρα ’took away (my) honey-sweet life’)
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θύρῃσιν: θύρα — door; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic θύραις)
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὃς δέ κ’ … ἵκηται ’whoever comes’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κ’ ἐλθὼν … εἴποιμι ’and I would go and tell’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καί νύ κ’ … ἔδυ ’and … would have set’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (τοὺς δέ κ’ … θέλξει ’and then … will enchant them’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ μέν κ’ αἰνήσωσι ’if they approve’) · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (τόν κ’ εἴ μοι δοίης ’if you would give me him’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κ’ αὐτὸν γνώω ’if I come to know him’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κ’ … ἐρεθίζω ’so that I may provoke’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that’ (ὥς κ’ … ἵκηται ’so that he may reach’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if you should wish’ (αἴ κ’ ἐθέλῃσθα)
κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’ · also plain acc. sg., direct object of a verb: κινήσας κάρη ’shaking his head’ · also acc. sg. governed by ἀμφί: ’about the head’ (ἀμφὶ κάρη) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’the head’ (κάρη κονίῃσιν ἐμίχθη)
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + aor. indic., unreal past: κέν μοι … κατέχευας ’you would have poured on me’ · also + subj. in a main clause: ’may’ (καί κέν οἱ ὑπέρσχῃ χεῖρα ’and he may hold his hand over him’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (κέν μοι … εἴη ’would be mine’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέν τις … ὀρέξῃ ’if perhaps someone holds out’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κέν … μεταλλῶσιν ’whenever they ask’) · also + opt., potential, in a clause with ὅ ’that’: ’might’ (ὅ κέν τις … ἀμύνοι ’that someone might defend’)
κίονα: κίων — pillar, column; fem. acc. sg. (κίων is feminine in this use) · also masc. acc. sg., with μακρὸν agreeing in the masculine: ’a tall pillar’ (πρὸς κίονα μακρὸν)
κακοΐλιον: Κακοΐλιος — ’Evil Ilium’, ill-omened Troy (κακός + Ἴλιος); fem. acc. sg.
κακόν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. sg.: ’a bad thing, evil’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal passive (κακόν τ’ ἀγαθόν τε τέτυκται ’whatever, good or bad, has come to pass’) · also neut. nom. sg. adjective agreeing with πέλωρ: ’evil’ (πέλωρ κακόν ’an evil monster’) · also neut. nom. sg. noun, predicate: ’an evil’ (ἀθάνατον κακόν ’an immortal evil’) · also neut. nom. sg. noun with a comparative, predicate: ’a greater evil’ (μεῖζον … κακόν)
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κακὰ ἔργα ’bad deeds’
κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’by an evil (fate)’, inner acc. with μόρον · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (τι … κακὸν … μελέτω ’let no evil thing be a care’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’harm, evil’ (κακὸν ἀλλοδαποῖσι φέροντες ’bringing harm to men of other lands’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ἦμαρ: ’evil’ (κακὸν ἦμαρ ’the evil day’) · also masc. acc. sg., predicative: ’base, cowardly’ (κακὸν καὶ ἀνήνορα ’base and unmanned’) · also neut. acc. sg. attributive with πῆμα: ’evil’ (πῆμα κακὸν ’evil harm’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject: κακὸν … βάζειν ’(it is) bad to speak’ · also neut. acc. sg. governed by ἐς: ’into evil’ (ἐς κακὸν … βάλῃσθα) · also neut. acc. sg. subject of an infinitive: ’an evil’ (κακὸν ἔμμεναι ’that an evil is’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of εἴη: ’evil’ (μή τι κακὸν … εἴη ’and may no evil be’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ῥάκος: ’vile’ (ῥάκος ἄλλο κακὸν ’another, a vile rag’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a finite verb: ’an evil’ (ἐπεὶ κακὸν ἔμπεσεν οἴκῳ ’since an evil fell upon the house’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with γενοίμην: ’a bane, an evil (to them)’ · also masc. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’a base man’ (κακὸς κακὸν ἡγηλάζει) · also masc. acc. sg., attributive with θάνατον: ’evil’ (θάνατον … κακόν ’evil death’)
κακῶς: κακός — bad, evil; adv.: ’wickedly, shamefully’ · also ’miserably, in misery’ (ὀψὲ κακῶς ἔλθοι ’may he come late, in misery’)
κατέβαιν: καταβαίνω — go down, descend; impf. 3 sg., elided (κατέβαιν’ = κατέβαινε)
κατέδραθον: καταδαρθάνω — fall asleep; aor. 1 sg., epic (= Attic κατέδαρθον): ’I fell asleep’ · also aor. 3 pl. (same form), with dual subject: ’the two fell asleep’
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην ’I would fight’) · also + subj. in a relative clause of purpose: ’who are to’ (οἵ κε … ἀγγείλωσι ’who are to announce’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a main clause: ’will’ (αἶψά κε … ἀποτίσεται ’at once he will exact payment’) · also + aor. in a general relative clause: ’who would (decide)’ (οἵ κε … ἔκριναν) · also + opt. in a relative clause: ’whoever might’ (ὅς κε … πόροι ’whoever might offer’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κε … ἐντανύσῃς)
κεῖνος: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
κτήματ: κτῆμα — possession, property; neut. acc. pl., elided (κτήματ’ = κτήματα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’possessions … are’ (κτήματ’ ἔασι)
κτεινομένων: κτείνω — kill, slay; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. gen. pl.: ’being killed’
κτεῖνε: κτείνω — kill, slay; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκτεινε): ’killed’
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect (φίλον κῆρ ’in his own heart’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a verb: κῆρ ἤθελε ’my heart wished’ · also κήρ — death-fate, doom; fem. acc. sg., elided (κῆρ’ = κῆρα): ’death-fate’ (θάνατον καὶ κῆρ’ ’death and doom’) · also neut. acc. sg., after ἀμφί: ’around the heart’
λάϊνον: λάϊνος — of stone, stone; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic λίθινος)
λαβοῦσα: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having taken (me in)’
λευκῷ: λευκός — white, bright, clear; neut. dat. sg. (ὕδατι λευκῷ ’with bright water’) · also masc. dat. sg., instrumental, agreeing with ὀδόντι: ’with a white tusk’
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλιστα: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα: ’most of all, especially’ · also ’for the most part, mostly’ (μάλιστα ἦμαρ ’the greater part of the day’)
μάστακα: μάσταξ — mouth (poetic word, root of μασάομαι ’chew’); fem. acc. sg.
μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’ · also plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. noun, not adverbial: κῦμα μέγ’ ’a great wave’
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγαρον: μέγαρον — hall, main room of the house; acc. sg.
μέγαρόνδε: μέγαρον — hall, house; μέγαρόνδε ’to the hall’, adv., -δε suffix of direction
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’) · also μένω — stay, wait; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stay’
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται) · also with an infinitive used as an imperative, a prohibition: μή μ’ … καταλείπειν ’do not leave me’ · also negating a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that … not’ (ἵνα μή τι … ἀλγήσετε ’so that you may not suffer’) · also with the optative, a negative wish: ’may … not’ (μή … ἀντιβολήσαις) · also ὡς ἂν μή + subj., negative purpose: ’so that … not’ (ὡς ἂν μή σε κατατρύχῃ ’so that he may not wear you out’) · also + subj. giving the content of an oath, ’that no one …’ (ὀμόσσατε … μή τις … πλήξῃ ’swear that no one strike’) · also μή + subj. standing alone as a warning, ’lest’ (μή τίς τοι … ἀναστῇ ’lest someone rise up against you’) · also μή + fut. indic. in a fear clause: ’lest, I fear’ (μή τίς … νεμεσήσεται ’lest anyone resent’)
μακρὴν: μακρός — long, tall; fem. acc. sg.
μακρὸν: μακρός — long, far; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’far, loudly’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’tall’ (κίονα μακρὸν ’a tall pillar’)
μαῖα: μαῖα — good mother, nurse; fem. voc. sg.: ’nurse!’, a respectful address to an older woman
μεγάροιο: μέγαρον — hall; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · with acc. also ’in quest of, in search of’ (μετὰ χαλκόν ’after bronze’) · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also adverb, ’among them, in their midst’: μετὰ δὲ πρέπει ἀγρομένοισιν ’and he stands out among the gathered’ · also as preverb in tmesis (μετὰ … βεβήκει = μεταβεβήκει ’had moved on, passed on’) · also a plain adverb, ’afterwards’ (μετὰ γάρ τε καὶ ἄλγεσι τέρπεται ἀνήρ ’for afterwards a man takes pleasure even in pains’; some take it as ’among’ with ἄλγεσι) · also + dat. of the mind, ’in’ (μετὰ φρεσὶ σῇσι ’in your mind’) · also + dat. of the hands, ’in’ (μετὰ χερσὶν ἐνώμα ’was turning in his hands’)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μνηστῆρες: μνηστήρ — suitor; nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’suitors!’
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of the person affected, ’from my …’ (μοι βλεφάρων ἐξέσσυτο ὕπνος ’sleep rushed out from my eyelids’) · also dat. of possession with εἰμί: ’who are mine’ (οἵ μοι ἔασιν ’who are mine’)
μοῦνος: μόνος (epic/Ionic μοῦνος) — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
μυχῷ: μυχός — innermost part, corner, recess; masc. dat. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
μῦθος: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said; masc. nom. sg.
νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
νέκυσσιν: νεκύς — dead man, corpse; masc. dat. pl., epic -σσιν
νημερτὲς: νημερτής — unerring, infallible; neut. acc. sg. used as a noun, direct object: ’the unerring truth’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’unerringly, truly’ (νημερτὲς ἐνίσπες ’tell unerringly’)
νοήματα: νόημα — thought, design, purpose; neut. acc. pl.
νόοιο: νόος — mind, thought, purpose; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ξεῖνος: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); nom. sg.
οἰκτίστῳ: οἰκτρός — pitiable, piteous; superlative οἴκτιστος, masc. dat. sg.: ’most pitiable’
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’) · also encl. dat. sg. of a thing, ’to/for it’ (δύω δέ τέ οἱ θύραι ’and it has two doors’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’those, the’ (οἱ πέπλοι ’the robes’) · also dat. sg. of the giver with δέχομαι: ’from him’ (οἱ ἐδέξατο ’took from him’)
οἴκαδ: οἴκαδε (elided οἴκαδ’) — homeward, to home; adv., -δε suffix of direction
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household (and its stores); acc. sg.
οἶον: οἶος — alone, only; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with the subject: ’standing alone’ (ὅ τε φαίνεται οἶον ’which appears alone’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with a neut. noun: ’alone, by itself’ (σάκος οἶον ’a shield alone’)
οἶσθα: οἶδα — know; perf. 2 sg. with pres. force: ’you know’
οὐδόν: οὐδός — threshold; masc. acc. sg.: ’threshold (of old age)’, a figure for reaching it · also the literal threshold of a house (ὑπέρβη λάϊνον οὐδόν ’stepped over the stone threshold’) · also the ground underfoot (a sense disputed): ’the ground’ (ἀρισφαλέ’ ἔμμεναι οὐδόν ’that the ground is very slippery’)
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐλήν: οὐλή — scar, healed wound; fem. acc. sg. (the accent keeps it apart from οὖλος ’thick, woolly’, fem. acc. οὔλην)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὖδας: οὖδας — ground, floor; neut. acc. sg.
οὗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (= Attic οὗ) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐξ οὗ ’since, from the time when’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own; masc. gen. sg. agreeing with a noun (οὗ πατρὸς ’her own father’s’)
πάλαι: πάλαι — long ago, of old; adv.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbial: ’altogether, in every respect’ (οὐκ ἄρα πάντα νοήμονες ’not altogether sensible’)
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πέποσθε: πάσχω — suffer; perf. 2 pl., epic πέποσθε (= Attic πεπόνθατε): ’you have suffered’
πέρ: περ — even, indeed; intensive/concessive particle, accented πέρ before the enclitic τε/τις that follows it; with εἰ: ’even if’
παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, among; + dat. · also + gen., ’from, from the side of’ (παρ’ Ἴλου ’from Ilus’) · also + acc., of motion, ’past, along, beside’ (παρ’ Μίμαντα ’past Mimas’)
παράκοιτις: παράκοιτις — bedfellow, wife; fem. nom. sg.
παρὲξ: παρέξ — beside, past, beyond; adv./prep. + acc., here adverbial with εἴποιμι: ’say otherwise, speak beside the point’ · also adv. with ἐλάσωσιν, ’past, beyond’ (τάς γε παρὲξ ἐλάσωσιν ’drive past them’) · also prep. + acc.: ’past, beyond’ (παρὲξ τὴν νῆσον ἐλαύνετε ’drive past the island’) · also adv., ’aside, apart, besides’ (ἄλλα παρὲξ μεμνώμεθα ’let us remember other things apart from this’)
παῖδ: παῖς — child, daughter; fem. acc. sg., elided (παῖδ’ = παῖδα) · also masc. acc. sg. (παῖς is common gender; here of a son, Telemachus): ’son’ · also masc. acc. dual, elided (παῖδ’ = παῖδε), with δύο: ’two sons’
παῖδα: παῖς — child, son, daughter; masc./fem. acc. sg.
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
περίφρων: περίφρων — circumspect, of sound understanding; fem. nom. sg., stock epithet of Penelope · also epithet of Arete: fem. nom. sg., ’the circumspect queen’ · also epithet of Eurycleia: fem. nom. sg., ’circumspect Eurycleia’
πηνελόπεια: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope, wife of Odysseus; nom. sg.
ποιῆσαι: ποιέω — make, do; aor. inf.: ’to make (an end)’
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’) · also neut. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. (κτήματα πολλὰ ’many possessions’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’again and again’ (πολλὰ περιτροπέοντες) · also neut. nom. pl. as substantive, subject: οἷά τε πολλὰ γίγνεται ’as many things happen’
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.
ποτιδέγμενος: προσδέχομαι (epic ποτιδέγμαι) — wait for, await, expect; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
ποῖόν: ποῖος — what sort of, what kind of; neut. acc. sg., reproachful: ’what a...’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἔπος: ’what a (word)’
πρίν: πρίν — before, until; conj./adv., + inf. (like Attic πρίν) · also + a temporal clause (πρίν γ’ ὅτ’ ἄν + subj.): ’until the time when’ · also πρίν κε + opt., an independent potential clause answering a suppressed protasis: ’sooner, before then’ (πρίν κεν ... ἵκοιο ’you would arrive home before then’) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article, no inf.: ’formerly, at first’ (parallel to the by-form πρὶν) · also πρίν γ’ ὅτε + aor. indic.: ’until the time when’ (a definite past terminus) · also πρίν γε + subj.: ’until’ (πρίν γ’ ἔτι … πειρήσεαι ’until you have tried’)
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive · also bare adv. ’formerly’, no art./inf. · also + aor. subj., ’before’ (πρὶν … ἐπέλθῃ ’before it comes upon’) · also + opt.: ’before’ (πρὶν τλαίη ’before he would bring himself’) · also adv. with a finite verb, ’before that, sooner’ (πρὶν … ἀγείρετο ’before that … came gathering’) · also + fut. indic.: ’before’ (πρὶν … γαῖα καθέξει ’before the earth covers’) · also with a bare noun, the verb understood: ’before’ (πρὶν ὥρη ’before it is time’) · also adv. ’till then, before that’ in a clause with no finite verb (πρὶν δ’ οὔ τι νεμεσσητὸν κεχολῶσθαι ’till then it is no cause for blame to be angry’)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’) · also + gen., of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς Βορέαο ’toward the North Wind’) · also + gen., in an appeal: ’by (your father)’ (πρὸς πατρὸς γουνάζομαι) · also as preverb in tmesis: με πρὸς μῦθον ἔειπε = με προσέειπε μῦθον ’spoke a word to me’ · also + gen., ’in the eyes of, with’ (πρὸς πόσιός τε καὶ υἱέος ’in the eyes of her husband and son’)
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’
πυθόμην: πυνθάνομαι — learn, learn by inquiry; aor. mid. 1 sg., unaugmented, in an unreal-past condition: ’I had learned’ · also plain narrative aorist: ’I learned’ (Ὀδυσῆος ἐγὼ πυθόμην ’I learned of Odysseus’)
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usu. with a negative
πόσιν: πόσις — husband; acc. sg. · also the distinct noun πόσις ’a drinking, drink’ (from πίνω); acc. sg.: ’drink’ (paired with βρῶσις ’eating’)
πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός — your, yours; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά): τὰ σ’ αὐτοῦ κήδε’ ’your own troubles’
σέ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’you’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’)
σανίδες: σανίς — board, plank, door-leaf; fem. nom. pl.
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
στυγερῶς: στυγερός — hateful, grim; adv. στυγερῶς: ’hatefully, grimly’
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
σφέας: σφεῖς — they; pron., masc. acc. pl., epic σφέας (= Attic σφᾶς), governed by διά: ’through them’ · also acc. pl. object of a verb of teaching: ’them’ (σφέας … ἐδίδαξε ’taught them’) · also acc. pl. reflexive object, with αὐτούς: ’themselves’ (πυκάζοιεν σφέας αὐτούς) · also acc. pl. direct object: ’them’ (Ζεὺς σφέας τίσαιτο ’may Zeus punish them’) · also acc. pl. object of a compound verb of coming: ’them’ (σφέας εἰσαφίκηται ’comes to them’) · also acc. pl. subject of an infinitive: ’them (to be)’ (σφέας … ἔμμεναι)
σφῶϊν: σύ (dual σφῶϊ) — you two; dual gen./dat. 2nd person, epic (= Attic σφῷν): ’from you two’
σὸς: σός — your, yours (2 sg. possessive); adj., masc. nom. sg.
σῆμα: σῆμα — mark, sign; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’sign’ (τόδε σῆμα τετύχθω ’let this sign be made’)
σῦς: σῦς — swine, pig, boar; masc./fem. nom. sg. · also masc./fem. acc. pl. (= σύας), object: ’swine’
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’ · also after ἤ ’than’, with no connective force: ἤ τ’ οἰωνοί ’than birds’ · also after ὅ ‘that’, with no connective force: ὅ τ’ οὐκέτι νόστιμός ἐστιν ‘that he is no longer returning’
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic) · also article-like with ἄλλα, ’the other (things)’ (τά περ ἄλλα ’in the other matters’) · also article-like before an adverb, ’the (things) within’ (τά τ’ ἔνδοθι)
τάφος: τάφος — amazement, astonishment; masc. nom. sg. · also τάφος — tomb, burial; masc. nom. sg. (homograph)
τέκνον: τέκνον — child; neut. voc. sg. (= nom./acc. in form)
τέκος: τέκος — child, offspring; neut. voc. sg. (φίλον τέκος ’dear child’)
τήν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg., resumptive: ’whom’ · also demonstrative, fem. acc. sg., resuming an earlier noun: ’her’ (τήν … ῥέξω ’her I will sacrifice’) · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὀιζυῖ πολλῇ, τήν μοι ἐπῶρσε ’great misery, which he roused for me’) · also demonstrative with a noun and adjective: ’that’ (τήν γε στυγερὴν ὁδόν ’that hateful journey’)
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ἤ, accented before the enclitic μοι: ’any’ (ἤ τί μοι … κειμήλιον ’or any treasure of mine’)
τίπτε: τίπτε — why ever, what then (= τί ποτε shortened); interrog. adv.
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
τίσαιτο: τίνυμαι — punish, exact payment from; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., wish: ’may he punish’
ταῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ταῦτ’ = ταῦτα): ‘these things’
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεοῖσι: τεός — your (sg.), of you; possessive adj., epic (Attic σός); masc./neut. dat. pl. -οισι (= Attic σοῖς)
τηλέμαχος: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; nom. sg.
τηλοῦ: τηλοῦ — far off, at a distance; adv.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’ · also as a substantive object in a statement: ’something’ (καί τι ἴσασι ’they know something’) · also neut. acc. sg. as object with a negative: ’anything’ (οὐδέ τι ῥέξαι ’nor to have done anything’)
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοιόνδε: τοιόσδε — such as this, of this kind; neut. acc. sg.
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’) · also demonstrative with a noun: masc. acc. pl. ’those, the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους … ἑταίρους ’the rest of my companions’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’ · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ: ’from that time’ · also neut. gen. sg., partitive, ’of it’ (τοῦ μὲν ὅσον τ’ ὄργυιαν ’of it, about a fathom’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the’ (τοῦ παιδὸς ’that son’) · also article-like gen. sg. with a noun and a participle (gen. absolute), distributive: ’of the one … of the other’ (τοῦ μὲν φθίνοντος μηνός, τοῦ δ’ ἱσταμένοιο ’as one month wanes and the other begins’)
τοῦτό: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. sg., accented before enclitic γ’ · also accented before enclitic τί (τοῦτό τί μοι ’this, I think’) · also accented before enclitic τοι: ’this, for you’
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg. · also with a noun, article-like: τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom; fem. acc. sg. (τὴν Ὠκεανὸς τέκε ’whom Oceanus begot’) · also ’the other’, contrasted with a preceding τὴν … μέν: fem. acc. sg. (τὴν δέ ’the other one’) · also article-like with a numeral: ’the one’ (τὴν μὲν ἴαν ’the one portion’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective: ’the like (one)’ (τὸν ὁμοῖον)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’) · also demonstrative of a thing just named, before a preposition: ’it’ (τῷ δ’ ἐν ’and on it’, τῷ δ’ ὑπό ’and beneath it’) · also adverbial, with κε: ’in that case, otherwise’ (τῷ κέ μιν … παύσαμεν ’otherwise we should have stopped him’)
υἱέϊ: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic υἱέϊ (= Attic υἱῷ)
φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with φρονέω: ’with friendly thoughts, kindly’ · also plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun: ’dear’ (τέκνα φίλα ’dear children’) · also neut. acc. pl. as substantive, object: ’dear things, kindnesses’ (φίλα ἔρδοι ’may do kindnesses’)
φίλη: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. in address: ’dear one!’
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’ · also masc. acc. sg. predicative, agreeing with a pronoun: ’as a friend, welcome’ (φίλον ἐλθεῖν) · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φαμένη: φημί — say, speak; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’so saying’
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φωνήσασ: φωνέω — utter, speak aloud, raise one’s voice; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (φωνήσασ’ = φωνήσασα)
φύγεν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔφυγε)
χαλεπόν: χαλεπός — hard, difficult, harsh; neut. nom. sg., impersonal predicate: ’(it is) hard’ · also masc. acc. sg., attributive: ’harsh’ (χαλεπὸν … μῦθον ’a harsh speech’)
χεῖρε: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. dual: ’his two hands’
χροῒ: χρώς — skin, flesh, the body’s surface; dat. sg. χροΐ
ἀγήνορας: ἀγήνωρ — very manly, overbearing, lordly (rendered ’lordly’ throughout); masc. acc. pl.
ἀγαυούς: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; masc. acc. pl.
ἀγορεύεις: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare, say; pres. 2 sg.

ἐτεὸν: ἐτεός — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly, in truth’
ἐφέστιος: ἐφέστιος — at one’s own hearth; adj., masc. nom. sg.

ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize, grasp; aor. act. part. masc. nom. sg. (ἑλών): ’having seized’
ἑὸν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc./nom. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (δῶμα ἑὸν ’his own hall’)

ἔασι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., epic (= Attic εἰσί): ’are’

ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that

ὕβριν: ὕβρις — insolence, wanton violence; fem. acc. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’) · also ὡς ὅθ’ (= ὡς ὅτε), ’as when’, comparing with an occasion in the past (ὡς ὅθ’ ὑπὸ Τροίην ’as when beneath Troy’) · also introducing an indirect statement after a verb of saying: ’that, how’ (εἴποιμ’ ὡς … ἔρχομαι ’I might tell how I am coming’) · also ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἄν τίς σε … μακαρίζοι ’so that someone … would call you blessed’) · also ὡς + participle, ’as one who’ (ὡς ἐκ θανάτοιο φυγόντα ’as one escaped from death’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … ἔρχησθον ’so that you two may go’) · also ὡς = ’to, toward’ + acc. of a person (ὡς τὸν ὁμοῖον ’to the like’) · also exclamatory ὡς + finite verb: ’how’ (ὡς ὁ μολοβρὸς … ἀγορεύει ’how the glutton talks’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’ · also introducing a wish with the optative: ’so may…’ (ὣς ἔμ’ ἀϊστώσειαν ’so may they make me vanish’)
ὤλεσε: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’destroyed’
ὤλετο: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented: ’has perished, is gone’
ὥρμαιν: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, turn over in mind; impf. 3 sg., elided (ὥρμαιν’ = ὥρμαινε)
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also ὥς ’just as’, in ὥς περ (accented before enclitic περ) (ὥς περ ὑπέστης ’just as you promised’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic με (ὥς με κελεύεις ’as you bid me’) · also postpositive after its noun, comparative ’like’ (οἰωνῶν ὥς ’like birds’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τοι (ὥς τοι ἐγὼν ἐρέω ’as I shall tell you’) · also correlative ’so’ answering ὅπως, introducing a wish with the opt., accented before the enclitic τοι: ’so may’ (ὥς τοι Ζεὺς τελέσειεν ’so may Zeus fulfil it for you’) · also with a plain subj. (no κε/ἄν), purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς τοι δῶρ’ ἀποπέμψω ’so that I may send you the gifts’) · also ὥς accented before enclitic οἱ, of measure: ’as much as’ (ὥς οἱ χεῖρες ἐχάνδανον ’as much as his hands could hold’) · also exclamatory, ’how’, accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τις θαρσαλέος … ἐσσι ’how bold you are’) · also with the plain optative (no κε/ἄν), purpose, accented before the enclitic μιν: ’so that’ (ὥς μιν ψυχὴ λίποι ’so that life should leave him’) · also ὡς ’as, how’, accented before enclitic μοι (ὥς μοι ἰνδάλλεται ’as it seems to me’) · also ὡς ’how’, introducing a narrated event, accented before the enclitic μιν (ὥς μιν θηρεύοντ’ ἔλασεν ’how he struck him as he hunted’) · also ὡς ’as, like’, accented before enclitic τις (ὥς τις ’like some’)
ᾤχετ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ᾤχετ’ = ᾤχετο): ’went’
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg. (same form), agreeing with a neut. noun: πεδίοιο ... ᾧ ἔνι ... ’a plain in which is...’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἄχεϊ: ’her own (grief)’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
